Document: CIR-2026-08 "Revision of the Sleeper class Tatkal charge" (effective from 2026-10-01). Language: English.
Write each section below as 1-4 clear sentences for passengers, using ONLY the facts given.
Keep every number, amount, percentage, time, date and document ID exactly as given, using Western
digits (0-9) even in Hindi. Write dates in the YYYY-MM-DD form given. Do not add any other numbers,
rules, phone numbers, websites or contact details.
Sections (name: facts):
- "1. Revised Tatkal charges": With effect from 2026-10-01, the Tatkal charge per passenger is SL Rs 175 (earlier Rs 150), 3A Rs 300, 2A Rs 400.

sections.text: With effect from 2026-10-01, the Tatkal charge per passenger is SL Rs 175 (earlier Rs 150), 3A Rs 300, and 2A Rs 400. These charges apply to all Tatkal bookings in Sleeper, AC 3 Tier and AC 2 Tier classes.
